en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a richly decorated historic brick building on a street corner. The façade has stepped gables, tall mullioned windows with shutters, and a row of statues between the upper and lower windows. At the back rises a tower with a distinctive bulbous (onion-shaped) dome and finial. People are cycling and walking in the cobblestone street in front; a parking sign with a 'P' is visible. The overall style is late Gothic/Renaissance typical of Low Countries town halls.
